VBO:0201177.summary: Sapsaree preservationist Ha Ji-hong describes these Korean dogs as gentle and strongly loyal. Their modern revival grew from the eight dogs he found in his father’s preservation kennel in 1985. Decades of work at Gyeongsan brought the shaggy native breed back from the brink.
VBO:0201177.shortDescription: Described by preservationist Ha Ji-hong as gentle and loyal, this Korean dog owes its revival to dedicated breeding.

sources.title: Kim Min-joo — Direct interview with Sapsaree preservationist Ha Ji-hong (2018)
sources.evidence: Ha directly describes sweet/gentle temperament and loyalty. He recalls finding eight Sapsarees at his father’s preservation kennel in1985 on returning from US study, and reporter describes decadeslong preservation work in Gyeongsan. These support attributed character and narrow modern revival history, no ancient ancestry or individual guarantees.
